name: smwmusic-mega-man-zx-advent-whisper-of-relics
title: Mega Man ZX Advent - Whisper of Relics
description:
Faithful recreation of Whispers of Relics from Mega Man ZX Advent. It has some hair of finality, so it could fit for final levels.

This one was tricky. To get past the polyphony issue I had to make several samples for the choir and for the flute, so I could have a little more flexibility there.
